in_marathi.name: Rajanikanth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajanikanth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajanikanth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Raja' which means 'ruler' and 'Nikantha' which means 'destroyer of enemies'. This name is given to a boy as a symbol of strength and leadership, signifying the power to rule over one's domain and protect it from adversaries.
